question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"considered."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Considered"** means to think about something carefully before making a decision. ((निर्णय लेने से पहले) किसी बात पर सावधानी से विचार करना; सोचना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She had never **considered**__ nursing as a career.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank in this context.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• **Correct passage**:

Amla tree is __**considered**__ to be thousands of years old. It is called aamaleki and dhaatri in Sanskrit. Its botanical name is Emblica Officinalis. The amla tree is a medium ______ (2) ______ tree with citrus fruits. It is found almost everywhere in India ______ (3) ______ for some very high mountainous regions. It is found ______ (4) ______ in Madhya Pradesh. The leaves are very small and have a close ______ (5) ______ to those of Gulmohar. The amla tree has slender branches which grow upwards and surround the trees on all sides.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **'Reviewed' **means to examine something in order to make a judgement about it. ((किसी बात का) पुनः परीक्षण या उस पर पुनर्विचार करना (उसमें परिवर्तन की आवश्‍यकता पर निर्णय हेतु))
 
• **'Examined' **means to inspect something closely in order to determine its nature or condition. बहुत सावधानी से किसी विषय, धारणा आदि पर विचार करना)
 
• **'Contemplated'** means to think about something deeply or at length. (किसी विषय या संभावना पर सावधानी से विचार करना चिंतन करना)

42:Td1d,
The correct answer is **"sized."**
